name: SOURCE
threshold: every published row carries an official source link or an explicit UNVERIFIED marker
why: the brief's verification rule; without it nothing downstream is trustworthy
measured: verified by verify.py on every build

name: SAMPLE
threshold: n >= 300 graded prospective bets before any strategy leaves paper
why: exact-binomial power: proving a true 55% hit rate at 80% power needs about 2243 bets; 300 is the minimum for any rank to be interpretable

name: PRICE
threshold: opening and closing market prices captured for >= 95% of originated markets
why: without a market price there is no residual, no CLV and no ROI

name: AVAILABILITY
threshold: >= 2 dated reads per game week for >= 28 of 32 clubs, with retained hashes
why: the injury signal must be a surprise, which needs a prior read to be a surprise against

name: DEPTH
threshold: machine-readable depth with an explicit date and source for >= 30 of 32 clubs
why: the deficiency matrix needs both sides of every pairing

name: OUTCOMES
threshold: official finals ingested for >= 2 full seasons
why: a chronological holdout and a multi-season split both need more than one season

name: JOINT
threshold: a directly validated joint probability plus the operator's void/push rules before any combo is ranked
why: multiplying marginals is invalid under dependence

name: OUTCOMES-AVAILABILITY
why: the label cannot be a feature until its reliability is measured

name: REPRO
threshold: deterministic rebuild plus a row-level provenance audit on the generated HTML
why: without it no published number can be re-derived
measured: verified by verify.py on every build
